intent: Однократно выставить ожидаемые 600 МГц DDR через live PLL write и наблюдать результат до следующей перезагрузки

register_plan.expectation_provenance: inferred_from_current_raw field, 24 MHz parent formula and /4 divider; target rate was never read back

captured_before_disconnect.transport_observation: SSH stopped responding after watchdog_armed; no target register readback reached the controller host

candidate_result.reason: The board became unreachable before any post-arm evidence was captured. Program order and lost transport do not prove whether the MMIO write instruction executed.

recovery.reset_mechanism: consistent_with_armed_sunxi_wdt_timeout; exact reset-cause register was not captured

postboot_registers.provenance: fresh root read-only register inspect plus clk_summary after reboot

postboot_integrity.journal_observation: system.journal corrupted or uncleanly shut down, renaming and replacing
postboot_integrity.filesystem_error_attribution: The journal line proves an unclean reset, not GGUF corruption. No offline fsck was run on the mounted root filesystem.

measurements.reason: The attempt failed before a verified candidate state, so workloads were deliberately not reported as 600 MHz results.

conclusion: 600 MHz was not established. The only verified post-attempt operating point is the reboot-restored 510 MHz state. Do not use this run in speedup charts as a 600 MHz datapoint.
